title: Cover letter, handed over
spec: User hands over a cover letter with almost no context. AI writes all of it and picks the angle. User accepts it as is.

messages.content: write me a cover letter for a junior data analyst job at a bank

Here's a cover letter you can adapt:

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Data Analyst position at your bank. With a strong foundation in statistics, hands-on experience with SQL and Python, and a genuine interest in how data can improve financial decision-making, I believe I can contribute from day one.

In my studies I built dashboards that tracked customer churn and automated weekly reporting, which taught me to turn messy data into clear recommendations. I am particularly drawn to the banking sector because small improvements in risk models and customer insight have a large real-world impact.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my analytical skills and attention to detail can support your team.

Kind regards,
[Your name]

I focused the letter on impact and reliability, since banks value both. Replace the bracketed parts and add one concrete project if you have one.
Glad it helps! Good luck with the application.
